name: 7ki Slack triage
description: When a #7ki-agents message starts with fix: or review:, start a cloud agent and open a draft PR. Humans approve.
instructions: Read the Slack message. Route api/client/bo keywords to the matching repo. Implement on a feature branch and open a DRAFT pull request. Never merge. Never approve. Never use production DATABASE_URL or wallet keys. Do not run Strix. Reply in the thread with the PR link.
